account.title: GitHub
account.description: Connect GitHub to bring files from your repositories into your projects.
account.intro: Once connected, open a project’s Repository tab to link one of your repositories, private ones included, and choose which files to sync. ReelBolt only reads from GitHub and never changes anything there. You can remove ReelBolt’s access from your GitHub settings at any time.
account.moreRepos: Give ReelBolt access to more repositories on GitHub
account.revoked: {reason, select, user_revoked {ReelBolt’s access was revoked in your GitHub settings.} other {Your previous GitHub connection stopped working.}} Connect again to keep linking repositories.

connect.unavailableTitle: GitHub is not available here yet
connect.unavailableBody: Linking GitHub repositories is not set up on this server yet. Ask your administrator to turn it on.
connect.intro: You sign in with GitHub and approve ReelBolt there — there is no password or token to copy. ReelBolt can then list the repositories you choose to share with it, and read their files. It never changes anything on GitHub.
connect.revoked: {reason, select, user_revoked {ReelBolt’s access was removed in your GitHub settings.} other {Your earlier GitHub connection stopped working.}} Connect again to continue.

link.heading: Link a GitHub repository
link.intro: Bring files from a GitHub repository into this project and keep them up to date: every push to the branch you choose updates them here. ReelBolt only reads your repository — it never changes it — and it never touches files you or an agent added to the project yourselves.
link.step3: Choose a branch and the files to sync
link.linkAndSync: Link and sync {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}

linked.unlinked: Repository unlinked. The files it brought in are still in this project.
linked.everyPush: Every push to {branch} updates this project’s files. ReelBolt only reads the repository — it never changes it.
linked.syncingBody: ReelBolt is copying the chosen files into this project. A large choice can take a few minutes. You can leave this page — the sync carries on, and the files copied so far are kept even if it is interrupted.
linked.failedTitle: The last sync did not finish

linked.prefixNote: This link was made for the folder {prefix}, so files are chosen from inside it. To sync files from elsewhere in the repository, unlink and link it again.
linked.unticked: Files you untick are removed from this project on the next sync; files you or an agent added yourselves are never touched.
linked.connectToChange: Connect your GitHub account to change which files this project syncs.
linked.unlinkMessage: Pushes to {repo} will no longer update this project. The files it already brought in stay in the project — nothing is deleted.
